summary: Itaú Unibanco filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 1Q 2026 quarterly results, including financial statements and management discussion. The filing announces a press presentation and interactive meeting scheduled for May 6, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is described. The Form 6-K is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer providing periodic financial results, with no special-situation event.
